headline: FII10 has been postponed to 2027, and Intersec Saudi Arabia and the Saudi Retail Forum moved the same day, removing the Kingdom's main 2026 deal-signing week. US court filings tying the detained ex-OpenAI engineer to a Saudi royal add a reputational overhang to KSA-US AI partnerships as the Pentagon threatens export controls on AI labs. Gulf compute deals kept closing without a named OEM: stc Bahrain-NBB, G42/MBZUAI/Analog-AMI Labs and Hyperfusion-VAST. Memory tightened further: KB says 80% of Samsung's 2027 output is booked, Nomura sees shortage to 2028, Micron's Taiwan union strikes on 22 Oct and Nvidia warned Chinese buyers of 5-10% fills.
lenovo_read: With FII gone, rebuild Q4 KSA executive access one-to-one in the vacated week. Sell delivery certainty and price-locks: memory and GPU allocation, not price, now decides 2027 wins, and the NBB, Egypt and Hyperfusion builds have no named OEM.

pillars.dc: 7 scored: stc Bahrain-NBB DC, Hyperfusion-VAST modular AI DC (UAE), Egypt national DC strategy, Rönesans-Digital Realty Ankara groundbreaking, Hubco delay (Pakistan), center3-Epsilon IX, Anthropic-Nscale second $45bn talks. No new KSA build; HUMAIN Al-Saad only re-reported.
pillars.memory: 7 scored: Nvidia China RTX PRO 5500 allocation, PC brands' LTA pivot (Lenovo named), KB on Samsung 2027 bookings, Nomura shortage to 2028, TrendForce News 4Q DRAM +20% relay, Micron Taiwan strike, Omdia India smartphones -26%. DRAMeXchange 20 Oct: DDR5 16Gb $60.700 (+0.11%).
pillars.deals: 4 scored: TAWAL-Samsung SmartThings Pro, UAE-France AI MoUs (G42/MBZUAI/Analog-AMI Labs), OIC cyber council to Riyadh, OpenAI raise with MGX. No KSA/GCC round of $20M or more.
pillars.global: Samsung (TAWAL, Jazz, Asiacell), Digital Realty (Ankara), Microsoft (QSTP), Dell (PureCS, doubleAI), Oracle (M42), Nvidia (China allocation). Chinese rule: ByteDance/Alibaba/Tencent scored; ZTE and Huawei items held.

stories.title: FII Institute postpones 10th annual conference to 2027
stories.summary: The FII Institute moved FII10, scheduled for Riyadh on 26-29 Oct, to 2027 with a new date to be announced soon; registrations and partnerships remain valid. Media tie the move to Houthi strikes; the institute cites quality and scale.
bullets: The FII Institute told participants that the event, originally scheduled to take place in Riyadh from Oct. 26 to 29, has been postponed to 2027
The institute said the decision was made to ensure the milestone 10th edition delivers the full scale, quality and impact expected, with a new date to be announced soon
All existing registrations and partnerships for the conference will remain valid
stories.lenovo: FII week was the densest access point to PIF, HUMAIN, Aramco, stc and NEOM leadership. Convert side meetings (OPP-075) to one-to-one Riyadh meetings or DCD>Connect MENA and GITEX Global.
stories.arabic: أجّل معهد مبادرة مستقبل الاستثمار النسخة العاشرة من المؤتمر، التي كانت مقررة في الرياض من 26 إلى 29 أكتوبر، إلى عام 2027، مع بقاء التسجيلات والشراكات سارية وإعلان الموعد الجديد قريباً.

stories.title: Ex–OpenAI engineer accused of bugging office stays in jail as prosecutors allege Saudi ties: ‘Once he leaves, there’s no getting him back’
stories.summary: A US judge kept Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former OpenAI engineer and Saudi national, in custody until 6 Nov. Prosecutors allege contact with a member of the Saudi royal family who sought to recruit him for a Saudi AI effort.
bullets: A federal judge ordered Abdulrahman Alfozan, a 35-year-old former OpenAI engineer, held in custody until his preliminary hearing on Nov. 6; the FBI arrested him on Oct. 9
Prosecutors allege he planted a recording device in an executive conference room on Sept. 28

He faces one count of using or attempting to use a device to intercept oral communications, carrying a maximum of five years in prison; he has not been indicted and the complaint does not charge espionage
stories.lenovo: Reputational overhang for KSA-US AI partnerships as Washington tightens AI-lab controls. Position compliance-ready, auditable AI-factory builds with clear GPU and model chain of custody.
stories.arabic: أمرت قاضية أمريكية باستمرار احتجاز المهندس السابق في أوبن إيه آي عبدالرحمن الفوزان حتى جلسة 6 نوفمبر، فيما يزعم الادعاء تواصله مع أحد أفراد الأسرة المالكة السعودية بشأن الانضمام إلى مبادرة سعودية للذكاء الاصطناعي.

stories.title: TAWAL Signs Agreement with Samsung for Network Asset Monitoring and Management
stories.summary: stc Group's tower company TAWAL signed a supply and training agreement with Samsung Electronics Saudi Arabia for SmartThings Pro asset monitoring across its tower estate. No value disclosed.
bullets: TAWAL signed a supply and training agreement with Samsung Electronics Saudi Arabia to use the SmartThings Pro platform for monitoring network assets
The agreement covers multi-site management, automated alerts, energy data analytics and reporting, and asset-tracking devices, with TAWAL systems connected through enterprise APIs
TAWAL operates more than 30,000 telecommunications towers across Saudi Arabia, Bulgaria, Croatia, Slovenia and Pakistan
stories.lenovo: Samsung (competitor) won the IoT layer at stc's tower arm; edge compute for tower analytics is unnamed, a ThinkEdge angle via solutions by stc.
stories.arabic: وقعت توال التابعة لمجموعة stc اتفاقية توريد وتدريب مع سامسونج السعودية لاستخدام منصة SmartThings Pro لمراقبة وإدارة أصول الشبكة عبر أكثر من 30 ألف برج، دون الإفصاح عن القيمة.

stories.title: Center3 and Epsilon Telecommunications partner to expand access to internet exchanges in Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: center3 appointed Epsilon as reseller partner for its one-IX internet exchange platform in Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam, powered by LINX since 2019.
bullets: center3 has appointed Epsilon Telecommunications as the reseller partner for its one-IX Internet Exchange platform
Networks and providers can peer at center3's IX platforms in Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam through Epsilon's international connectivity ecosystem
center3's Internet Exchange platform has been powered by the London Internet Exchange (LINX) since 2019
stories.lenovo: More peering supports colocation demand in center3 DCs; ecosystem context for OPP-067, not a hardware buy.
stories.arabic: عيّنت سنتر3 التابعة لمجموعة stc شركة إبسيلون شريكاً لإعادة بيع خدمات منصة تبادل الإنترنت one-IX في جدة والرياض والدمام، لتوسيع الربط الدولي لمراكز بياناتها.

stories.title: Riyadh chosen to host OIC’s first Cybersecurity Ministerial Council
stories.summary: OIC foreign ministers approved a Saudi proposal for an OIC cybersecurity ministers' council with its secretariat and executive office in Riyadh.
bullets: The 52nd session of the OIC Council of Foreign Ministers approved the establishment of an OIC council of ministers of cybersecurity, following a proposal by Saudi Arabia
The council's general secretariat and executive office will be based in Riyadh, and it will comprise the cybersecurity authorities of OIC member states
National Cybersecurity Authority Governor Majed Al-Mazyed said the proposal came amid growing cyber threats to vital interests, critical infrastructure and government services
stories.lenovo: NCA's standard-setting reach grows across OIC markets; lead public-sector bids with NCA-aligned security and cyber-recovery (OPP-070).
stories.arabic: وافق مجلس وزراء خارجية منظمة التعاون الإسلامي على مقترح سعودي بإنشاء مجلس وزراء الأمن السيبراني للمنظمة، على أن تكون أمانته العامة ومكتبه التنفيذي في الرياض.

stories.title: Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and French President attend UAE-France Business Dialogue to strengthen strategic partnership in energy and artificial intelligence
stories.summary: MBZUAI, G42 and Analog signed MoUs with AMI Labs; ADNOC Gas signed with Schneider Electric and ADNOC Refining with Technip Energies. No values or hardware disclosed.
bullets: Three MoUs were signed with AMI Labs: MBZUAI for AI research and development, G42 for cloud computing infrastructure and AI models, and Analog for integrating AI models into robotics and physical AI
ADNOC Gas and Schneider Electric signed an MoU to evaluate advanced technologies to improve operational efficiency in energy systems
ADNOC Refining and Technip Energies signed two contracts, for a refining capacity enhancement project and a sustainable aviation fuel project
stories.lenovo: Hardware undisclosed, an open ISG opportunity, though G42 leans Microsoft and Dell. ADNOC Gas-Schneider is an energy-OT edge angle for ThinkEdge.
stories.arabic: شهد ولي عهد أبوظبي والرئيس الفرنسي توقيع ثلاث مذكرات تفاهم بين جامعة محمد بن زايد وجي42 وأنالوج مع مختبرات AMI في الذكاء الاصطناعي والحوسبة السحابية والروبوتات، إضافة إلى اتفاقيات لأدنوك مع شنايدر وتكنيب.

stories.title: Stc Bahrain partners with NBB Group to modernize Data Center infrastructure and elevate financial sector capabilities
stories.summary: stc Bahrain completed phase 2 of NBB Group's data-centre transformation, moving Bahrain Islamic Bank services onto the group platform. OEM and value undisclosed.
bullets: stc Bahrain partnered with National Bank of Bahrain Group to upgrade its Data Centre infrastructure in the second phase of the Group's transformation program
The project deployed resilient infrastructure in NBB Group's new Data Centre, allowing Bahrain Islamic Bank services to move onto the Group's strategic platform
stc Bahrain served as project coordinator and implementation partner, handling project governance and delivery across multiple stakeholders
stories.lenovo: Bank DC refresh with OEM undisclosed, an open ISG opportunity for later DR, storage and AI phases through stc Bahrain as SI.
stories.arabic: نفذت stc البحرين المرحلة الثانية من تحديث البنية التحتية لمركز بيانات مجموعة بنك البحرين الوطني، ما أتاح نقل خدمات بنك البحرين الإسلامي إلى المنصة الموحدة للمجموعة، دون الإفصاح عن القيمة أو الموردين.

stories.title: VAST Data and Hyperfusion Accelerate AI Infrastructure Deployment from Years to Weeks
stories.summary: UAE-based Hyperfusion adopts the VAST AI OS for its Sentinel 45-ft modular AI data centres (96-GPU reference build) and multi-MW HyperPods, for sovereign and air-gapped deployments.
bullets: VAST Data and Hyperfusion will integrate the VAST AI Operating System into Hyperfusion's Sentinel modular AI infrastructure as its preferred data platform

Sentinel packs an AI data center into a transportable 45-foot ISO High Cube unit with a 96-GPU reference configuration and about two to three petabytes of capacity, while each HyperPod scales to roughly 20 petabytes
Sentinel supports confidential computing, can run fully air-gapped, and can be delivered as a customer-owned system or a managed service keeping data in-country
stories.lenovo: GPU-server OEM undisclosed, an open ISG opportunity; Lenovo liquid-cooled 8-GPU nodes and Neptune fit the pod.
stories.arabic: أعلنت فاست داتا وهايبرفيوجن الإماراتية دمج نظام VAST في وحدات Sentinel المعيارية لمراكز بيانات الذكاء الاصطناعي، بحاوية 45 قدماً تضم 96 معالجاً رسومياً، مع إمكانية التشغيل المعزول وإبقاء البيانات داخل الدولة.

stories.title: Egypt's play to become an exporter of computing power
stories.summary: Egypt will finalise its first national data-centre strategy before end-2026; installed IT load is 15-60 MW with about 20 MW of new capacity firmly committed.
bullets: Estimates put Egypt's installed data center IT load at 15 to 60 MW, with only about 20 MW of new capacity firmly committed

Africa Data Centres Egypt, a consortium of Vodafone Business, Elsewedy Electric and Cassava Technologies, has committed to 20 MW within three years and hopes to reach 200 MW with up to USD 1 bn in investment
Khazna, the data center arm of G42, plans a 25 MW facility in Maadi with local partner Benya Group
stories.lenovo: A national strategy means tenders; Orange Egypt's AI DC talks have no OEM named. Use Cairo ICT (7-10 Nov).
stories.arabic: تعتزم مصر إنهاء أول استراتيجية وطنية لمراكز البيانات قبل نهاية 2026، فيما لا تتجاوز القدرة الملتزم بها نحو 20 ميغاواط، مع مشاريع مخططة لأفريقيا داتا سنترز وجلف داتا هب وخزنة.

stories.title: Digital Realty breaks ground on 22 MW Ankara data center
stories.summary: Digital Realty and Rönesans broke ground on a 22 MW Ankara data centre due in 2028, with Istanbul next; the minister cited a $4.1bn full build and a 1 GW national target by 2030.
bullets: Digital Realty has started construction on its first data center in Türkiye, a 22 MW facility in Ankara built through a joint venture with Rönesans Infrastructure
Land, power and permits were already secured, and the facility is expected to be completed in 2028, with a second data center planned in Istanbul
Mordor Intelligence projects Türkiye's data center capacity to grow from 350 MW in 2025 to 570 MW by 2031
stories.lenovo: Tenant IT undisclosed, an open ISG opportunity; updates OPP-006/OPP-059 from JV to construction.
stories.arabic: بدأت ديجيتال ريالتي بناء أول مركز بيانات لها في تركيا بقدرة 22 ميغاواط في أنقرة مع رونيسانس، على أن يكتمل في 2028، ضمن هدف تركي لبلوغ 1 غيغاواط بحلول 2030.

stories.title: Hubco Delays Data Center Project
stories.summary: Hub Power Company delayed its data centre on power and technology costs and uncertain returns, preferring a 100 MW entry; Huawei is attached to rival Quantum Global DC.
bullets: Hub Power Company has delayed its proposed data center project because of high electricity and technology costs, significant infrastructure requirements and uncertain financial returns, according to a Topline Securities note
The company prefers to enter the market at around 100 MW rather than with smaller 5-10 MW facilities
There is no information on a revised launch date, estimated investment amount or final project structure
stories.lenovo: Pakistan power economics stall private DCs; target operational sites (Sky47, Indus/UBL) and government programmes.
stories.arabic: أجّلت شركة هب باور الباكستانية مشروع مركز البيانات المقترح بسبب ارتفاع تكاليف الكهرباء والتقنية وعدم وضوح العوائد، مفضلة الدخول بقدرة 100 ميغاواط بدلاً من 5 إلى 10 ميغاواط.

stories.title: Anthropic eyes second $45 billion Nscale deal as 460MW AI data centre plans advance ahead of potential IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic is in talks for a second ~$45bn Nscale compute deal for a 460 MW building at Monarch, West Virginia, on Nvidia Vera Rubin; ADIC is among Nscale's pre-IPO investors.
bullets: Anthropic is in talks for a second deal with Nscale, potentially worth about $45 billion, covering a second 460-megawatt data centre at Nscale's Monarch campus in West Virginia using Nvidia's Vera Rubin chips
Nscale already has an agreement with Anthropic worth as much as $44.6 billion, according to its IPO documents
Nscale raised $3.36 billion in a pre-IPO round from investors including Third Point, Nvidia, Apollo, Citadel, Hudson Bay Capital and the Abu Dhabi Investment Council
stories.lenovo: Frontier-lab demand props up leveraged neoclouds (OPP-085); system OEM undisclosed. Sell to buyers with power secured.
stories.arabic: تجري أنثروبيك محادثات لصفقة ثانية بنحو 45 مليار دولار مع إن سكيل لمبنى بقدرة 460 ميغاواط في فرجينيا الغربية بشرائح فيرا روبين، فيما يضم مستثمرو إن سكيل مجلس أبوظبي للاستثمار.

stories.title: Why OpenAI is racing to raise $30 billion before Anthropic IPO
stories.summary: OpenAI is accelerating a ~$30bn raise at more than $1.4tn before Anthropic's November IPO; SoftBank and Abu Dhabi's MGX are discussing participation.
bullets: OpenAI is accelerating plans to raise about $30 billion before Anthropic's expected November stock market debut, at a valuation that could exceed $1.4 trillion
Existing backers, including SoftBank and Abu Dhabi's MGX, are discussing participation, though commitments have not been finalised
OpenAI is pitching annualised revenue of $50 billion following the release of GPT-6 Astra and expects that figure to reach $70 billion by year-end
stories.lenovo: MGX keeps doubling down on US frontier labs; indirect for Lenovo, with Stargate UAE hardware still undisclosed.
stories.arabic: تسعى أوبن إيه آي لجمع نحو 30 مليار دولار بتقييم يتجاوز 1.4 تريليون دولار قبل طرح أنثروبيك المتوقع في نوفمبر، مع مناقشة مستثمرين حاليين بينهم سوفت بنك وشركة إم جي إكس الإماراتية المشاركة.

stories.title: Emil Michael tells The Information export controls can rein in AI labs
stories.summary: The Pentagon CTO said export controls can be used against AI labs that do not cooperate, citing the controls placed on Anthropic. No new rule was issued.
bullets: Emil Michael, the Pentagon's chief technology officer, said the US government can use export controls against AI companies that won't cooperate with it
He said Anthropic was placed under export controls within two hours of refusing to withdraw a model after the government discovered it had been jailbroken
About 1.7 million of the department's 3.5 million employees now use AI, up from 80,000 a year earlier
stories.lenovo: Model-level controls would decide which frontier models Gulf sovereign AI can run on-prem; favours open-weight, in-country stacks on Lenovo AI factories.
stories.arabic: قال المسؤول التقني في البنتاغون إميل مايكل إن الحكومة الأمريكية يمكنها استخدام ضوابط التصدير ضد شركات الذكاء الاصطناعي غير المتعاونة، مستشهداً بفرض قيود على أنثروبيك خلال ساعتين.

stories.title: Exclusive-ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent place over $35 billion worth of Nvidia chip orders
stories.summary: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent ordered more than 3m RTX PRO 5500 cards (>$35bn at list); Nvidia warned of 5-10% fills, with deliveries from Q1 2027.
bullets: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered more than 3 million Nvidia RTX PRO 5500 cards at about $11,400 each, a potential combined value above $35 billion, according to two sources
Nvidia told partners they might receive only 5% to 10% of the quantities requested, with total orders from Chinese customers topping 6 million
Customers were told to expect commercial deliveries of the RTX PRO 5500 starting in the first quarter of 2027
stories.lenovo: Direct allocation squeeze on professional GPUs behind ThinkStation and inference servers; lock META H1 2027 allocations now (OPP-072, OPP-086).
stories.arabic: طلبت بايت دانس وعلي بابا وتنسنت أكثر من 3 ملايين بطاقة إنفيديا RTX PRO 5500 بقيمة تتجاوز 35 مليار دولار، فيما حذرت إنفيديا من أن العملاء قد يحصلون على 5 إلى 10% فقط من الكميات المطلوبة.

stories.title: Major PC Brands Pivot To Enterprise Customers To Secure Profitability By Locking In Long-Term Memory Deals For 2027 As Soaring Prices Deter Consumers
stories.summary: Lenovo, HP and Dell reportedly shift to enterprise buyers and lock long-term memory deals through 2027 after receiving only 70-80% of requested DRAM/SSD in H1 (rumour-grade, ETNews).
bullets: Lenovo, HP and Dell reportedly saw consumer sales plummet as higher RAM prices made PCs unaffordable and are shifting toward enterprise customers
PC brands reportedly received only 70-80% of the DRAM and SSD volumes they requested in the first half and are turning to long-term agreements to secure supply through 2027
Omdia estimates global PC shipments fell 21% year-over-year in Q3 2026 and expects a further 7% decline in 2027
stories.lenovo: Names Lenovo. Prioritise government, bank and enterprise refresh with price-locked multi-quarter supply in META.
stories.arabic: تفيد تقارير بأن لينوفو وإتش بي وديل تتجه نحو عملاء المؤسسات وتوقع عقوداً طويلة الأجل لتأمين الذاكرة حتى 2027، بعد حصولها على 70 إلى 80% فقط من الكميات المطلوبة في النصف الأول.

stories.title: Samsung's 2027 memory output already 80% booked: KB Securities
stories.summary: KB Securities' Kim Dong-won estimates about 80% of Samsung's 2027 memory output is under long-term contract and HBM ASPs rise 100-150% next year (estimates).
bullets: KB Securities estimates Samsung Electronics has locked in roughly four-fifths of its planned 2027 memory output through long-term supply deals
Kim Dong-won, head of research at KB Securities, said five-year contracts cover 70 percent of Samsung's planned conventional DRAM and NAND flash output
KB Securities projects Samsung's 2027 operating profit will climb 51 percent to 555 trillion won ($417.6 billion) and expects HBM average selling prices to rise 100 to 150 percent next year
stories.lenovo: Little open 2027 supply raises spot exposure for smaller rivals; Lenovo LTA coverage is a delivery-certainty weapon.
stories.arabic: تقدّر كيه بي للأوراق المالية أن سامسونج حجزت نحو 80% من إنتاج الذاكرة المخطط لعام 2027 بعقود طويلة الأجل، مع توقع ارتفاع أسعار ذاكرة HBM بين 100 و150% العام المقبل.

stories.title: [News] DRAM Prices Seen Rising 20% QoQ in 4Q26 Despite Slower Gains; AI Demand, Tight Supply Support Outlook
stories.summary: A relayed report sees 4Q26 DRAM contract prices up about 20% QoQ after about 80% in Q2 and 40% in Q3; TrendForce research remains +10-15%.
bullets: Fourth-quarter 2026 DRAM contract prices are projected to rise about 20% quarter-on-quarter, slowing from roughly 80% in Q2 and 40% in Q3
Per MoneyToday, DRAM spot prices continue to rise, while CXMT's 4F² DRAM faces yield, leakage current and data retention challenges, with full commercialization expected after 2028
Per TrendForce, 8-Hi HBM is expected to cost 10-20% more per Gb than 12-Hi in 2027
stories.lenovo: Increases are slowing, not reversing; keep price-protection clauses on Q4 META quotes (OPP-088).
stories.arabic: تشير تقديرات إلى ارتفاع أسعار عقود الذاكرة DRAM بنحو 20% على أساس فصلي في الربع الرابع 2026، بتباطؤ عن 80% في الربع الثاني و40% في الثالث، مع استمرار صعود الأسعار الفورية.

stories.title: Nomura Keeps Buy on Samsung, SK hynix, Sees Memory Shortage Through 2028
stories.summary: Nomura sees the memory shortage lasting through 2028, keeps Buy on Samsung (KRW670,000) and SK hynix (KRW4.7m), and sees new DC capacity rising 41.3% to 31.5 GW next year.
bullets: Nomura Securities expects the memory chip shortage to persist through 2028 and kept buy ratings on Samsung Electronics and SK hynix
Nomura set target prices of 670,000 won for Samsung Electronics and 4.7 million won for SK hynix
Nomura estimates new global data center capacity will rise about 41.3% to 31.5 gigawatts next year from 22.3 GW this year
stories.lenovo: Multi-year META AI-factory and fleet proposals should carry indexation or allocation language, not fixed memory pricing.
stories.arabic: أبقت نومورا على توصية الشراء لسامسونج وإس كيه هاينكس متوقعة استمرار نقص الذاكرة حتى 2028، مع ارتفاع سعة مراكز البيانات الجديدة عالمياً 41.3% إلى 31.5 غيغاواط العام المقبل.

stories.title: Micron's Taiwan Union to Strike on the 22nd Over Profit-Sharing Demand
stories.summary: Micron's Taoyuan union strikes on 22 Oct seeking 15% of operating profit; Taiwan supplies about 50-60% of Micron's output.
bullets: The Taoyuan union, representing about 15% of Micron's Taiwan workforce, approved the strike with 88.3% in favor, while the Taichung union has not yet held a strike vote
Micron offered compensation equal to 35 to 68 months of base pay, while the union wants a one-time bonus of 83 months' pay and 15% of operating profit distributed to workers
Micron employs about 15,000 people in Taiwan and sources roughly 50% to 60% of its chip output from the island
stories.lenovo: First labour risk at a top-three DRAM/HBM supplier in a shortage; watch allocation notices and keep alternate sources qualified.
stories.arabic: تعتزم نقابة عمال ميكرون في تاويوان بتايوان الإضراب اعتباراً من 22 أكتوبر مطالبة بـ15% من الأرباح التشغيلية، علماً بأن تايوان توفر نحو 50 إلى 60% من إنتاج الشركة.

stories.title: India's smartphone shipments plunge 26% in Q3, worst showing since 2016
stories.summary: Omdia: India smartphone shipments fell 26% to 35.6m in Q3 as memory costs pushed prices up; Samsung led, Vivo fell 34%.
bullets: India's smartphone shipments fell 26 per cent year-on-year to 35.6 million units in Q3 CY2026, the sharpest decline since CY2016, according to Omdia
Rising memory prices forced manufacturers to keep raising handset prices
Samsung shipments fell 1 per cent to 6.7 million units, displacing Vivo at the top, while Vivo shipments plunged 34 per cent to 6.4 million units
stories.lenovo: Memory inflation shrinks mass-market phones in shared price bands (Pakistan, Egypt, Africa); Motorola META should compete on value-mid tiers and operator financing.
stories.arabic: تراجعت شحنات الهواتف الذكية في الهند 26% إلى 35.6 مليون وحدة في الربع الثالث، الأسوأ منذ 2016، بسبب رفع الأسعار مع ارتفاع تكلفة الذاكرة، وتصدرت سامسونج السوق.
